identity.name: Variational Omni Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Perp

about.description: TTWO is a cash settled perpetual market on Variational Omni referencing Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.. The market is quoted and margined in USDC on Arbitrum, marked against the Omni Liquidity Pool's aggregated reference price rather than a single venue, and it conveys no ownership of the underlying and no claim on the issuer.
